_what: qal/tankfed FINAL -- top-up DESTINATION (bank vs TANK) x tank SIZING (uniform vs per-bank matched), real sha_slice bank-size profile 48/19/3/1/2

instrument._decks: instr_anchor.cir / instr_probe.cir are md5-identical to qal/lsweep/h_L15_W30_dv120.cir / p_L15_W30_dv120.cir; instr_free.cir / instr_clamp.cir are md5-identical to qal/skiptu/r_s4_free_T200_dv1200_L5_W10_t12_f0.cir / r_s4_rtu_T200_dv1200_L1_W10_t20_f0.cir

anchor_b_clamp_damage._NOTE_on_the_committed_convention: the committed 'free' control deck instantiates NO top-up device on banks 3 and 4 at all, while the clamp deck instantiates one AND fires it.  So the committed +113.565 mV conflates the top-up EXISTING with the top-up FIRING.  chain3 measured that merely having the gate present shifts t_zcs by +11.5 ps and VBEND2 by -43.4 mV, so the conflation is not negligible.  Every free control in qal/tankfed carries the top-up devices PHYSICALLY PRESENT and parked off, which isolates the firing term.  This anchor is reproduced on the committed convention so the instrument is anchored; the run's own numbers use the stricter one.

damping._what: series-RLC damping of each hop, per configuration. R_eff is MEASURED from the deck (peak dV across the loop / peak current); C_ser and R_crit are DERIVED.

MEASURED_matched_m6_hop1.note: at the current peak the inductor voltage is zero, so (V_src - V_dst)/I is the loop series resistance directly: two tg15p transfer gates in series (source-side cut + destination side) plus RS = 10 ohm.

cost.provenance: MEASURED from the PDK: .param cap_carea = 1.5E-15 (F/um^2) in /usr/local/src/IHP-Open-PDK/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerCAP.lib, cmim typ; 0.9x/1.1x at the CAP corners.

inductors.note: 4 hop inductors for a depth-5 chain (one per hop). The CLAMP top-up adds none. The PULSED buck adds one per topped bank (2 here). L = 15 nH each; on-chip nH-class inductors are the known area/Q problem and are NOT costed in um^2 here -- that is a BOUND, not a result.

cost.LABELS: tank area and C_bank: MEASURED (PDK density x MEASURED capacitance). top-up charge/energy: MEASURED charge from a 1F integrator on the dV source, times the IDEAL 1.2 V source voltage -- the source is ideal, so the energy is a LOWER BOUND (a real regulator delivering it costs more). Gate-drive energies: MEASURED from 1F integrators on the real PWL gate sources, so they include the gate charge but NOT the cost of generating the PWL -- also a LOWER BOUND. Inductor area: NOT COSTED, a BOUND.

results.cap_density_provenance: MEASURED from the PDK: cap_carea = 1.5E-15 F/um^2 (cmim, typ) in ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerCAP.lib; 0.9x / 1.1x at the CAP corners
